recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast nighttime photograph of a backyard swimming pool and roofline, overlaid with vibrant, hand-drawn neon-style doodles that introduce surreal objects and abstract energy patterns.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition of realistic photography with flat, gestural line art
Interaction between the physical environment and illustrated elements
Contrast between deep blue water and vibrant red/white outlines
Dynamic tension between the resting human figure and chaotic doodles
coreInvariants: Thick, consistent-width digital brush strokes for overlays
Primary color palette for illustrations (Red, White, Yellow)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man lies on a roof in the upper right; a large illustrated car sinks into a central pool.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red illustrated car in the center of the blue pool.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the figure on the roof, down the white line to the pool, and finally to the text in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows in the upper background and lower right patio areas.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (water ripples and furniture outlines)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red (central car and figure highlights) and yellow (typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between dark shadows and luminous, high-saturation overlays.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with irregular, hand-drawn execution
letterConstructionRules: Intentional shakiness and varying letter heights
Open counters and simplified geometric forms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letter 'A' lacks a crossbar or uses a low-slung one
Letter 'O' is rendered as a square with rounded corners
Exclamation points integrated into the baseline

composition.position: Top left and bottom right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single consistent hand-drawn style across all text elements.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric but manual feel of the characters
Matches the stroke quality of the illustrations

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast night photo of a modern backyard with a pool and a man lying on a shingled roof, lit by harsh artificial light.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply thick, hand-drawn vector outlines in red and white to define a car in the pool and furniture on the patio. Add yellow hand-lettered text in the top-left and bottom-right corners.

verificationChecks: Are the doodles vibrant and flat against the photographic background?
Is the text rendered in a shaky, monolinear yellow style?
Is the car in the pool the primary red focal point?
Is there a clear distinction between the photo and the illustration layers?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the water ripple doodles
Pose of the figure on the roof
mustRedesign: Specific band names or album titles
Exact facial features of the figure
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red car appears to be 'sinking' into the blue pool.
Check that the white lines follow the contours of the water and roof.
Verify the yellow text is legible but maintains a raw, hand-drawn quality.
Confirm the background remains dark enough to make the overlays pop.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Nighttime Backyard Photography] with [Neon Primary Color Doodles] and [Corner-Aligned Hand-Lettering] to create a surreal, mixed-media composition.
